unit: CH-03 F053 / F116 - backend producer convergence + narrow Meetings identity crossing
orderingRationale: Backend first, per founder direction: the client boundary cannot become canonical while producers keep hand-selecting person fields. PERSON_IDENTITY_SELECT -> producer consistency -> AuraPersonIdentity.fromJson -> consumer consistency.

backendMigrated.note: The highest-density cluster. TWO person shapes repeated ~20 times: a bare reference {id, handle, displayName} and an admin view {id, email, handle, displayName [, disabledAt]}. Both now compose PERSON_REFERENCE_SELECT plus their admin domain fields.

Account records compose the person reference alongside credential/lifecycle fields (passwordHash, emailVerifiedAt, disabledAt, accountType). Two sites remain and are recorded below as a governed exception.
assignedAdmin / user / admin references. One of them selected {id, displayName} with NO handle - a person projected without the field needed to address them.

backendNonConformant.note: 45 of the remaining 60 are backend; the rest are client NON_CONFORMANT avatar sites.

personIdentitySelectAuthority.why: No field was added, renamed or forked. Every migration COMPOSES the existing PERSON_REFERENCE_SELECT; no SECOND_PERSON_IDENTITY_SELECT was created and no service-specific person subset was invented.
personIdentitySelectAuthority.referenceVsIdentity: PERSON_REFERENCE_SELECT was the correct composition for every site touched: they embed a person inside another entity's response and need addressing, not lifecycle/verification. PERSON_IDENTITY_SELECT remains for surfaces that genuinely project the full person.

governedExceptionsRetained.why: They read the account record for CREDENTIAL work (password verification, verification-state transitions), not to embed a person in another entity's response. Composing full identity there would attach avatar/verification data to a login query for no consumer. The person subset they do carry was converged; what remains is account state.

The narrow founder authorization named exactly two CLIENT files. Backend Meetings services were NOT authorized and were not touched. 20 sites, executable in minutes under an equivalent narrow authorization.
Not yet classified; left rather than guessed.

privateTypedBoundaries.note: The 75 typed-boundary sites are unchanged by this batch, which was producer-side. They remain the architectural remainder and the closure path for F116.

narrowMeetingsCrossing.authorization: FOUNDER RULING 2026-08-19 - exactly two client files, for F053/F116 person-identity convergence only.

create_meeting_screen.dart.change: The PERSON half of an institution member row is read canonically. `title`, `role` and `canSpeakOfficially` are membership state, not identity, and were left untouched.

institution_availability_screen.dart.change: The SAME `_memberName` resolver existed TWICE in this file, byte for byte, each ending in the literal 'Unknown'. Both now read the canonical model with the shared fallback order - two duplicate person interpretations removed, not merely renamed.
institution_availability_screen.dart.discovery: A duplicated private resolver inside one file is the F053 defect in miniature: the same payload read twice, by two copies of the same code, in the same screen.

narrowMeetingsCrossing.boundaryRespected: No Meetings lifecycle, booking, availability, navigation, admission, waiting-room, realtime, participant-role or UI change. Only person-identity interpretation.
narrowMeetingsCrossing.regressionResult: MEETINGS BEHAVIOR PRESERVED - frontend meetings 31 PASS, backend meeting/availability/booking 12 suites / 125 tests PASS.

identityDebt.instrumentCorrections: NONE this batch - every cleared site is a real migration.
identityDebt.ratchet: FAILED on each reduction until re-frozen; re-frozen at 43 / 86.

remainderShape.backendNonConformant: 45 sites / 20 files - of which 20 are protected Meetings-family backend
remainderShape.f116ClosureTest: Not yet met. Producers are substantially converged; the private typed boundaries are not, so arbitrary private readers still exist and F116 remains PARTIAL by its own stated test.
